name: randoroute-ios-shell
description: Capacitor iOS wrapper for the Just Rolling Along bicycle-routing app.

scripts.ios:prepare-shell: npm run data:compress-overlays && npm run maps:registry && node scripts/build_mobile_shell.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run ios:prepare-shell && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:prepare-shell && cap build ios
